occurrences.key: skills/super-code/coordinator.js:1511 — Resumed records whose tracker beads are partly open enter closeAlreadyMerged, which calls confirmClosure. That function calls clearPendingClosure at line 1246; noteRecovery/readRecovery remove the pending-closure obligation immediately, before the buffered ledger:<id> append is confirmed. closeAlreadyMerged then settles completed at line 1270. If ledger:<id> and its retry return null (or report appended:false), drainLedger merely drains the chain and the run returns completed with the recovery obligation absent. The new confirmation-aware Resume fast path at lines 724–731 only protects records observed fully closed at the first observation. This violates the brief's requirement to drain confirmed closure/updated obligation records before treating recovery as settled, and the report's claim that in-memory obligations change only after confirmed append. Route partial-close completion through the same confirmed durable transaction, retaining the original record and a scoped recovery-held result on failed append. Add a targeted fixture with an initially open associated bead, successful close/check, and failed ledger:<id> append/retry; assert recovery remains unresolved and a subsequent restart observes facts rather than blindly repeating closure.
